svg.title: Two partitions for the same free-group averaging bound
svg.desc: For t=ab, r=ba and q=dad, the first case uses C, D and translates r to the j D. When d begins with exactly one b, conjugation by b inverse changes the translating word to t and uses the swapped partition C prime, D prime. Both cases yield norm at most twice the norm of x divided by the square root of N.
svg.text: t = ab, r = ba, q = dad; v = tᵐwt⁻ᵐ, w ≠ 1, m > ℓ(w)
Initial block of d is not b¹
C: initial aᵏ (k ≠ 0) or b¹; D = F ∖ C, with 1 ∈ D.
Initial block of d is b¹: d = bh
The first letter of h uses neither a nor b. Conjugate by λᵦ*.
C′: initial bᵏ (k ≠ 0) or a¹; D′ = F ∖ C′, with b⁻¹rb = t.
Either partition: ‖N⁻¹ Σⱼ uⱼ x uⱼ*‖ ≤ 2‖x‖ / √N, with uⱼ = λ(rʲqtᵐ).
Exact inclusions: FGA-03. Orthogonal ranges and norm bound: FGA-04–05.
